content.title: Vendor Profile & Experience
content.content: This section provides comprehensive information on SnapLogic's corporate profile, leadership, financial stability, aerospace manufacturing experience, compliance certifications, and professional services capabilities required for {{customer_name}}'s vendor qualification process.

subsections.title: Company Overview
subsections.content:
SnapLogic is an enterprise software company headquartered in San Mateo, California, USA. The company was founded in 2006 by Gaurav Dhillon, who previously co-founded and led Informatica Corporation — one of the defining enterprise data integration companies of its era. SnapLogic was founded with a specific mandate: to build the next generation of data integration and automation software for the API economy and modern cloud era, combining ETL with a modern, cloud-native, low-code architecture.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.06.50.png:Company Overview and Key Facts]

**Headquarters**: San Mateo, California, USA

**Global Offices**: London (UK), Amsterdam (Netherlands), Munich (Germany), Hyderabad (India), Melbourne (Australia), New York (USA)

**Employees**: 600 globally, including pre-sales, engineering, customer success, and support teams with presence across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions

**Ownership**: Privately held. Principal investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Salesforce Ventures, Capital One Ventures

**Customer Base**: 600+ enterprise customers including Global 2000 companies across financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and aerospace supply chains

**Analyst Recognition**:
- Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS: 11 consecutive years recognized (last 5 years as Leader or Visionary in iPaaS)
- Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools: Recognized (7 years)
- Forrester Wave for iPaaS: Named a Leader (Q3 2025)

**Business Value**: Former Total Economic Impact study (2020): 181% ROI over 3 years, payback period under 6 months, $1.7M in efficiency gains, $1.4M in technology savings per representative customer

**References**: SnapLogic can provide reference conversations with aerospace and manufacturing customers upon request, subject to NDA and customer approval

subsections.title: Leadership & Management Team
subsections.content:
SnapLogic's executive team combines deep enterprise software, integration, and AI expertise. In August 2025, SnapLogic completed a planned leadership transition — marking a milestone moment that coincided with the company surpassing $100M in Annual Recurring Revenue.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.06.55.png:Leadership and Management Team]

**Brad Stewart — CEO**: Brad Stewart was appointed Chief Executive Officer in August 2025. An experienced executive with a track record of scaling high-growth technology and services companies, Stewart joined at a pivotal moment — SnapLogic's strongest quarter in company history for ARR and pipeline growth, with over 20% of new and expansion sales driven by AI and agentic integration. His stated focus is building on SnapLogic's position at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise automation.

**Jeremiah Stone — CTO**: Jeremiah Stone serves as Chief Technology Officer, responsible for SnapLogic's platform architecture, product direction, and AI capabilities including SnapGPT, AgentCreator, and the agentic integration roadmap. Jeremiah is the executive sponsor of SnapLogic's AI-first product strategy.

**Gaurav Dhillon — Founder & Chairman**: SnapLogic was founded by Gaurav Dhillon, who previously co-founded and served as CEO of Informatica — the defining enterprise data integration company of its era. Dhillon transitioned to Chairman in August 2025 after leading SnapLogic from founding through its $100M+ ARR milestone. He remains an advisor to the company. The company's deep integration heritage and domain expertise stems directly from this founding background.

[BOX:info]
SnapLogic has 21+ customers spending $1M+ annually and processes 5 trillion records monthly — evidence of a mature, production-scale enterprise platform under new leadership with strong operational momentum.
[/BOX]

subsections.title: Financial Stability & Corporate Structure
subsections.content:
SnapLogic is a financially stable, growth-stage enterprise software company. As a privately held organisation, SnapLogic does not publish public financial statements. However, the company is willing to provide financial information under NDA for the purposes of this evaluation.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.07.22.png:Financial Stability and Corporate Structure]

**Revenue model**: Predictable, capacity-based subscription (Annual Recurring Revenue). Revenue is not tied to data volumes, seats, or per-pipeline fees — providing customers with cost predictability as adoption scales.

**Investor backing**: Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Salesforce Ventures, and Capital One Ventures — institutional investors with long-term enterprise software investment mandates.

**Growth trajectory**: Consistent year-on-year ARR growth driven by enterprise expansion and AI-led new business. SnapGPT and agentic capabilities are the primary growth drivers for 2025–2026.

**Financial documentation available under NDA**: Upon execution of an NDA, SnapLogic can provide a financial summary including revenue range, growth rate, and an investor comfort letter confirming the company's financial health and runway.

[BOX:warning]
**TO FILL: SEAN (AE) / FINANCE — FINANCIAL SUMMARY FOR NDA DISCLOSURE**

Request NDA-covered financial summary from SnapLogic Finance for inclusion or reference in the submission. Confirm whether {{customer_name}} procurement requires a formal financial statement or whether an investor comfort letter is acceptable.
[/BOX]

subsections.title: Aerospace Manufacturing Experience
subsections.content:
SnapLogic has proven deployment experience in aerospace and defense manufacturing environments with complex security, compliance, and operational requirements. Key experience areas relevant to {{customer_name}}:

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.18.34.png:Aerospace Manufacturing Experience Overview]

**CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE**

SnapLogic maintains security and compliance certifications required for aerospace manufacturing integrations, including SOC 2 Type II certification covering security, availability, and confidentiality controls. The platform supports:

- Data residency requirements (on-premises Ground Plex deployment ensures data never leaves customer infrastructure)
- Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
- GDPR compliance for European data processing
- ITAR compliance support (through on-premises deployment with no cloud data transit)
- ISO 27001 information security management

**SUPPLY CHAIN & QUALITY SYSTEMS**

Aerospace manufacturing involves complex integrations across:

- PLM systems (Teamcenter, Windchill) for engineering data and work instructions
- MES systems for production tracking and quality records
- ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) for procurement, inventory, and financial data
- Supplier portals and API integrations for supply chain visibility
- Quality management systems for non-conformance tracking and regulatory reporting

SnapLogic provides pre-built connectivity (Snap Packs) for PLM, MES, and ERP systems commonly deployed in aerospace manufacturing.

**REGULATORY & AUDIT SUPPORT**

Aerospace manufacturing requires extensive audit trails and regulatory documentation. SnapLogic provides:

- Pipeline execution logs with full lineage tracking (who ran what, when, and what data was processed)
- RBAC (role-based access control) with SSO and MFA support for user authentication
- Immutable audit logs for compliance review
- Data quality validation and error handling with alerting for production anomalies

**DEPLOYMENT EXPERIENCE**

While SnapLogic cannot disclose specific aerospace customer names without NDA and customer approval, the company has deployments supporting:

- High-value, low-volume manufacturing (aircraft, defense systems)
- Complex bill of materials (BOM) integrations with 10,000+ part numbers
- Multi-site manufacturing coordination across global facilities
- Supplier collaboration portals with API-based data exchange

[BOX:info]
**Reference Availability**: SnapLogic can arrange reference conversations with aerospace and defense customers subject to NDA and customer approval. Contact SnapLogic Sales Engineering for reference coordination.
[/BOX]

subsections.title: Certifications & Standards Compliance
subsections.content:
SnapLogic maintains enterprise security and compliance certifications required for deployment in regulated industries including aerospace manufacturing:

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.18.42.png:Certifications and Compliance Standards]

**SOC 2 TYPE II** — Security, Availability, Confidentiality

SnapLogic holds SOC 2 Type II certification covering security, availability, and confidentiality trust principles. The SOC 2 audit is performed annually by an independent third-party auditor and covers SnapLogic's cloud-hosted Manager control plane.

**ISO 27001:2013** — Information Security Management

SnapLogic is ISO 27001:2013 certified for information security management, demonstrating systematic management of sensitive company and customer information with risk-based controls.

**GDPR COMPLIANCE** — European Data Protection

SnapLogic is GDPR compliant for processing European personal data. For {{customer_name}}, the Ground Plex on-premises deployment ensures that all customer data remains within {{country}} and does not transit SnapLogic cloud infrastructure — providing data sovereignty and GDPR compliance by design.

**SECURITY PRACTICES**

- Annual penetration testing by independent security firms
- Vulnerability scanning and patch management with SLA-based remediation
- Secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) with automated security testing in CI/CD pipelines
- Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) for all data
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and single sign-on (SSO) support

**ITAR & EXPORT CONTROL SUPPORT**

For aerospace customers with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) requirements, SnapLogic's on-premises Ground Plex deployment ensures compliance by keeping all data processing within customer-controlled infrastructure. No data transits SnapLogic cloud, and all connector credentials are encrypted and stored locally.

[TABLE:simple:Security Certifications Summary]
| Certification | Standard | Scope | Audit Frequency |
|---------------|----------|-------|----------------|
| SOC 2 Type II | AICPA Trust Services | Security, Availability, Confidentiality | Annual |
| ISO 27001 | ISO/IEC 27001:2013 | Information Security Management | Annual |
| GDPR | EU 2016/679 | European Data Protection | Ongoing compliance |
| Penetration Testing | OWASP, SANS | Application and infrastructure security | Annual |
[/TABLE]

subsections.title: Professional Services & Implementation Capability
subsections.content:
SnapLogic's Professional Services organisation provides the delivery and enablement capability {{customer_name}} will require to deploy the platform, migrate existing pipelines, and enable the integration team. PS is a core part of the SnapLogic value proposition for complex enterprise deployments — not an afterthought.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.18.48.png:Professional Services and Implementation Capability]

**Team size**: 40+ PS consultants globally across AMER and EMEA

**Profiles**: Enterprise Architects, Senior Integration Consultants, Project Managers, Technical Trainers

**EMEA presence**: Consultants based in Germany, UK, Netherlands, France, Italy, Sweden — DACH delivery available in German

**Engagement models**: Time & Materials, Fixed-Deliverable Consulting, Managed Services (ongoing operational support)

**Partner ecosystem**: Large SI partners (Cognizant, Capgemini, Infosys, Wipro, TCS) and regional specialists (Blue Altair — 50+ SnapLogic-certified consultants) extend PS capacity for large-scale programmes

**Certifications**: SnapLogic Partner Certification Programme ensures consistent delivery quality across SI partners

[BOX:info]
**Prof. Services — confirm DACH PS resource availability for AH engagement**

Verify that SnapLogic Professional Services has German-speaking consultants available for Airbus Helicopters engagement delivery in DACH region.
[/BOX]

**TYPICAL ENGAGEMENT PHASES**

**Phase 1: Foundation** (Week 1-2)
- Ground Plex deployment on {{customer_name}} OpenShift infrastructure
- Connectivity validation to SAP, Oracle DW, Teamcenter PLM, and MES systems
- RBAC configuration and SSO integration with {{customer_name}} identity provider
- Monitoring and alerting configuration

**Phase 2: Pilot Migration** (Week 3-6)
- Select 3-5 representative Informatica mappings for conversion pilot
- Automated conversion using SnapLogic's Informatica migration tools
- Manual refinement and optimization of converted pipelines
- Performance testing and validation against Informatica baselines

**Phase 3: Team Enablement** (Week 4-8)
- Technical training: SnapLogic Designer, Snap configuration, expression language, error handling
- Best practices workshop: pipeline patterns, reusable assets, monitoring strategies
- Citizen Integrator enablement: SnapGPT-assisted pipeline generation for business analysts

**Phase 4: Production Migration** (Week 7-12)
- Remaining Informatica mapping conversion (automated + manual)
- User acceptance testing and production validation
- Cutover planning and execution support
- Hypercare period with SnapLogic PS on-site or remote support

**POST-IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT**

SnapLogic offers managed services for ongoing operational support including:
- Pipeline monitoring and incident response
- Performance optimization and scaling guidance
- New use case development and expansion
- Quarterly business reviews and roadmap planning
